# mergegateway_project_pi_settings (Resource)

Manages a project's prompt-injection (PI) protection overrides. Each setting left out inherits the organization's value. There is one per project: destroying it resets the project to inherit everything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergegateway_project" "support_bot" {
  name = "Support bot"
}

# Block prompt injection in the support bot's requests, more strictly than
# the organization does. Every setting left out inherits the organization's value.
resource "mergegateway_project_pi_settings" "support_bot" {
  project_id = mergegateway_project.support_bot.id

  pi_mode               = "block"
  pi_block_threshold    = 0.4
  pi_fail_closed        = true
  pi_allowlist_patterns = ["ignore previous order number"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the overrides apply to. Changing it moves the overrides: the old project is reset and the new one is set.

### Optional

- `pi_allowlist_patterns` (List of String) Patterns for text that is never flagged, kept in the order given. `[]` overrides the organization's patterns with none; leave it out to inherit them.
- `pi_block_threshold` (Number) The Tier 1 score at or above which `block` mode blocks a request. Between 0 and 1. Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.
- `pi_fail_closed` (Boolean) Block requests when PI detection fails, instead of letting them through. Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.
- `pi_indirect_mode` (String) Detection of indirect prompt injection: `off`, `alert` or `block`. Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.
- `pi_mode` (String) Prompt-injection detection on the request: `off`, `alert` (score but never block) or `block` (block when the score reaches `pi_block_threshold`). Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.
- `pi_output_action` (String) What to do when a response is flagged: `observe`, `redact`, `route`, `block` or `escalate`. Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.
- `pi_tier2a_block_threshold` (Number) The Tier 2A block threshold. Between 0 and 1. Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.
- `pi_tier2b_block_threshold` (Number) The Tier 2B block threshold. Between 0 and 1. Leave it out to inherit the organization's value.

### Read-Only

- `effective` (Attributes) The settings the project ends up with: each override, or the organization's value where there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective))
- `id` (String) The project's ID, the same as `project_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--effective"></a>

- `pi_indirect_mode` (String) The effective `pi_indirect_mode`.

- `pi_output_action` (String) The effective `pi_output_action`.
- `pi_tier2a_block_threshold` (Number) The effective `pi_tier2a_block_threshold`.
- `pi_tier2b_block_threshold` (Number) The effective `pi_tier2b_block_threshold`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project's PI settings by the project's ID.
terraform import mergegateway_project_pi_settings.support_bot 6f1c1f5e-8a8b-4c43-9a0e-3f0f6d0c8b11
```
